name: Company brain
blurb: A company's people, projects, claims, decisions and commitments, each tied to the exact words it rests on, shared by its people and agents.
about: Build a living company brain, and the agent workflows around it. It is one shared record of what a company knows: who is on which team, what each project is, what was said, what was decided and who owes what. Every claim carries the exact quote it rests on, so people and agents read the same account and can check it. Agents propose changes on their own branches, and a person reviews and merges them.

questions.q: Which decisions are current, project by project?
What does this decision rest on, and in whose words?
What did this meeting commit people to?
